note: حمل is a major homograph: حِمْل 'load/burden', حَمْل 'carrying/pregnancy', and حَمَلَ 'carried'. The current noun-only entry omits common meanings and the verb.
proposed_english: load; burden; carrying; pregnancy; carried (depending on vocalization/use)

note: كبار is the plural adjective 'big/large/major/senior' and can be substantivized as elders/senior people; noun-only POS is misleading.
proposed_english: big; large; major; senior; elders; senior people

note: شاهد is also the very common noun/active participle 'witness; observer; viewer/spectator', not only the perfect verb 'watched/saw/witnessed'.
proposed_english: witness; observer; viewer; spectator; watched; saw; witnessed (depending on use)

note: أصل can be أَصْل 'origin/root/basis' and أَصِلُ 'I arrive/reach', a common first-person imperfect reading omitted by the noun-only entry.
proposed_english: origin; root; basis; I arrive; I reach (depending on vocalization/use)

note: يقبل is a major unvocalized verb homograph: يَقْبَل 'accepts', يُقْبِل 'approaches/comes forward', and يُقَبِّل 'kisses'. Teaching only 'kisses' is materially incorrect for learners.
proposed_english: accepts; approaches; comes forward; kisses (depending on vocalization/form)

note: سن also represents the common verb سَنَّ 'enacted/established (a law or practice); sharpened', in addition to سِنّ 'age/tooth'.
proposed_english: age; tooth; enacted; established; sharpened (depending on vocalization/use)
